<!-- generated by docs/generate.sh - edit the javadoc in src/, not this file -->

A property is written on an element the way an html attribute is. Every element takes every property
here; what differs is which of them do anything, which the
[elements reference](/ctml/reference/elements) lists per element.

A boolean property needs no value: `draggable` on its own is the same as `draggable="true"`. Every
string is read through the dom context, so `${name}` anywhere in one is the variable of that name as
it stands this frame.

## `class`

The tailwind-like class list the element is styled from. Reading it again replaces everything the classes said before, which is what lets a callback show a box it had hidden; the property holds the list as it stands, so adding or taking away one class is an edit to that string.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ClassName` |

```html
class="flex flex-col gap-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700"
```

## `text`

The words the element shows. It is read through the dom context, so ${name} anywhere in it is the variable of that name as it stands this frame.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Text` |

```html
text="fps ${fps}"
```

## `draggable`

Lets the element be dragged around inside its parent's content box. Just the name is enough: <div draggable>.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Draggable` |

```html
<div class="w-8 h-8 bg-sky-600" draggable></div>
```

## `id`

The name a script can find the element again by, which is what getElementById looks up. An element given none gets one handed out in order the first time the context needs it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ID` |

```html
id="cookie-counter"
```

## `callback`

The name of a function the host put in the dom context. It hears about everything that happens to the element, not only the presses, so one that cares which is which asks the callback it is handed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Callback` |

```html
callback="clickCookie"
```

## `colspan`

How many columns of its table a cell takes up. It belongs to the cell, not to how it looks.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | td, th |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ColSpan` |

```html
<td colspan="2" text="both columns"></td>
```

## `rowspan`

How many rows of its table a cell takes up, the rows under it making room for it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | td, th |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.RowSpan` |

```html
<td rowspan="3" text="three rows"></td>
```

## `scrollx`

How far the content inside the element is scrolled sideways, which is how a script scrolls it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | any element that scrolls |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ScrollX` |

```html
scrollx="40"
```

## `scrolly`

How far the content inside the element is scrolled down, which is how a script scrolls it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | any element that scrolls |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ScrollY` |

```html
scrolly="120"
```

## `scrollinto`

The id of a descendant to bring into view, which is css's scrollIntoView. Set rather than read: whatever lays the element out takes the value off it, scrolls there and leaves it empty again.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element that scrolls |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ScrollInto` |

```html
scrollinto="last-row"
```

## `src`

The image an element shows, as the identifier a texture is held under: "craftytml:textures/gui/a.png".

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | img |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Source` |

```html
src="minecraft:textures/item/diamond.png"
```

## `tabindex`

Where the element comes in the tab order, the way html's tabindex does it: zero puts it in at its place in the markup, a positive number puts it ahead of those in that number's order, and below zero takes it out of the order while leaving it something a press can still focus.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.TabIndex` |

```html
tabindex="-1"
```

## `start`

What an ordered list counts from, which is one unless it says otherwise.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | ol |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Start` |

```html
<ol start="5"></ol>
```

## `reversed`

Whether an ordered list counts down instead of up.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | ol |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Reversed` |

```html
<ol start="3" reversed></ol>
```

## `value`

What an element holds. On a list item it is the number of that item, which the items after it carry on from; on an input, a textarea or an option it is the text, the number or the choice the element stands for, and it is rewritten as the user changes it, so reading it back gives what is on screen.

It is kept as text whatever it was written as, so value=7 and value="7" are the same thing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | li, input, textarea, select, option |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Value` |

```html
<input type="text" value="hello">
```

## `type`

What kind of input an input is: text, password, email, search, url, tel, number, checkbox, radio, range, hidden, button, submit or reset. Submit and reset are buttons, there being no forms for them to send or clear. One it does not know is read as text.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Type` |

```html
<input type="checkbox">
```

## `placeholder`

The dimmed words shown in a text field while it holds nothing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | input, textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Placeholder` |

```html
<input type="text" placeholder="your name">
```

## `checked`

Whether a checkbox or a radio button is ticked. It is rewritten as the user ticks it, so reading it back gives what is on screen.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Checked` |

```html
<input type="checkbox" checked>
```

## `name`

Which group a radio button belongs to: ticking one unticks every other radio button with the same name in the same screen.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Name` |

```html
<input type="radio" name="colour" value="red">
```

## `min`

The lowest a number or a range can go. A range starts at zero, and a number has no lowest unless this says so.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Min` |

```html
<input type="range" min=0 max=10>
```

## `max`

The highest a number or a range can go. A range stops at a hundred, and a number has no highest unless this says so.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Max` |

```html
<input type="range" min=0 max=10>
```

## `step`

How far one nudge moves a number or a range: the arrow keys, and where a dragged range lands. It is one unless this says so, and always a whole number.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Step` |

```html
<input type="range" min=0 max=100 step=10>
```

## `maxlength`

How many characters a text field takes. Typing and pasting stop at it; nothing is cut off a value that was written longer.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | input, textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.MaxLength` |

```html
<input type="text" maxlength=16>
```

## `disabled`

Takes the element out of use: it cannot be focused, typed into or pressed, and is drawn dimmed. On an option it cannot be chosen.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | input, textarea, select, option |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Disabled` |

```html
<input type="text" disabled>
```

## `readonly`

Lets a text field be focused, selected and read but not typed into.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | input, textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ReadOnly` |

```html
<input type="text" value="fixed" readonly>
```

## `selected`

Marks the option a select starts on. The first option is the one chosen where none says so.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | option |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Selected` |

```html
<option value="b" selected text="Bee"></option>
```

## `required`

Says the control has to be filled in. Nothing refuses to submit, there being no forms, but isValid on the element reports it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | input, textarea, select |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Required` |

```html
<input type="text" required>
```

## `autofocus`

Gives the control the keyboard when the screen opens. Where several say so, the first in the markup gets it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | input, textarea, select |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Autofocus` |

```html
<input type="text" autofocus>
```

## `minlength`

How many characters a text field has to hold to count as valid. Typing is never stopped by it; isValid on the element reports it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | input, textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.MinLength` |

```html
<input type="text" minlength=3>
```

## `pattern`

A regular expression the whole of a text field has to match to count as valid. One that does not compile is ignored. isValid on the element reports it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Pattern` |

```html
<input type="text" pattern="[a-z]+">
```

## `size`

How wide a text field starts out, in characters. A width class on the element wins over it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | input |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Size` |

```html
<input type="text" size=20>
```

## `rows`

How many lines tall a textarea starts out. A height class on the element wins over it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Rows` |

```html
<textarea rows=4></textarea>
```

## `cols`

How many characters wide a textarea starts out. A width class on the element wins over it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Cols` |


## `label`

The words an option shows, ahead of its text property and the words between its tags.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | option |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Label` |

## `autocomplete`

Read and kept like any other property, so a script can set and read it back, but nothing in ctml acts on it: there is no autofill to switch off.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | input, textarea, select |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Autocomplete` |

```html
<input type="text" autocomplete="off">
```

## `inputmode`

Read and kept like any other property, so a script can set and read it back, but nothing in ctml acts on it: there is no on screen keyboard to pick a layout for.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | input, textarea |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.InputMode` |

```html
<input type="text" inputmode="numeric">
```

Read and kept like any other property, so a script can set and read it back, but nothing in ctml acts on it: there is no file input to filter.
